briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: Welcome aboard the Bastion, Lancer. You are not a cadet any more, so I will skip the speech.
Two days ago the Skarn Dominion crossed the Velan line. Since then our long-range scopes keep picking up small contacts at the edge of the system - scouts, counting our ships.
You will fly the outer patrol: three navigation buoys, in order. If you meet those scouts, nobody goes home to report on us. Then come back to the Bastion.

steps.caption: You launch from the CNS Bastion, our fleet carrier and your home for this campaign.
Fly the patrol route: NAV 1, NAV 2 and NAV 3, in that order.
Scouts were last seen near NAV 2. Expect three Skarn Wasp interceptors.
When the route is clear, return to the Bastion's approach point.

intel: Hostile: 3x Skarn Wasp interceptor (light, fast, weak shields)
Craft: Executioner heavy fighter, twin lasers

messages.text: Lancer 1, you are clear. Patrol route is on your nav display.
Contacts near NAV 2! Three Wasps. Engage.
Scopes are clean. Nice shooting, Lancer.

debrief.win: Three scouts down and the picket line holds. The Skarn now know we are watching.
debrief.lose: We lost you on the patrol. Without that report, the Skarn will know exactly where the Bastion is.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The fleet runs on what those freighters carry: parts, ammunition, food. Two of them are leaving Halden for the jump gate at the end of the lane.
The lane is long and open, and the Skarn know the schedule. Fly escort with Lancer 2. Both freighters must reach the gate.
Keep the bombers away from the cargo. Interceptors are a nuisance; Talons are the real threat.

steps.caption: The freighters Mira and Tobin start here, heading for the gate.
The Halden jump gate, four kilometres down the lane. Once they reach it, they are safe.
Expect interceptors from the flank first, then Talon bombers going for the freighters.

intel: Hostile: Skarn Wasp interceptors, Skarn Talon bombers

objectives.text: Escort the convoy to the gate

messages.text: Convoy under way. Glad to have you along, Lancer.
Bombers inbound on the convoy, two o'clock low!
Gate lock. We owe you a drink, Lancer.

debrief.win: Both freighters made the jump. The fleet will eat this week.
debrief.lose: We lost cargo the fleet cannot replace.

briefing.location: Kestrel System - Outer comm relay K-7

lines.speaker: Mira’s captain
lines.text: We heard K-7 calling for help before the bombers showed up. I asked your escort to go back.

lines.speaker: Cmdr Ilse Varn
lines.text: And I ordered them to stay with you. That’s why both your ships are here.

lines.speaker: Mira’s captain
lines.text: I know. I’m asking you to go back now.

briefing.speaker: Lt. Commander Daro Okafor, Intelligence
text: Relay K-7 is how this system talks to the rest of the Concord. If it goes dark, the Bastion is alone out here.
We have intercepted Skarn traffic: they plan to hit K-7 with bombers in waves, trying to wear down whatever defends it.
Hold for two and a half minutes. By then the relay will have sent its backlog and the frigate Kestrel can take over the watch.

steps.caption: Comm relay K-7. Its core is fragile - keep the bombers off it.
Bomber waves will come from different directions. Watch the scanner.
Survive 150 seconds with the relay intact.

intel: Defend: Relay K-7 (one turret, fragile core)
Hostile: 4 waves of Talon bombers with Wasp cover

messages.text: K-7 to fighter cover: transmitting backlog now. Two and a half minutes.
New bombers on scope, from starboard!
Last wave, coming from below. Almost done!

debrief.win: K-7 finished its transmission. Fleet Command knows what is happening at Kestrel.
debrief.lose: K-7 is gone. We are deaf and mute until it can be rebuilt.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The scouts were spotting for something bigger. A Skarn corvette has been raiding our survey drones in the dust belt.
Corvettes are small for warships, but that one has turrets and a fighter screen. You are carrying torpedoes for this - use them on the hull, not on fighters.
Find it, kill it, come home.

steps.caption: The corvette patrols a loop through the belt.
Four Wasps fly escort. Thin them out or they will chase you off your attack run.
Torpedoes: target the corvette (T) and fire (G) from inside 1.5 km.

intel: Torpedoes home on the selected target

messages.text: Corvette is on your scope, Lancer. Good hunting.
Corvette destroyed! The belt is ours again.

debrief.win: The corvette Vesk is debris. Survey drones are flying again.
debrief.lose: The corvette got away, and it will be back.

briefing.speaker: Lt. Commander Daro Okafor, Intelligence
text: Someone is supplying the Skarn from inside our own space. We traced it to the cargo yard at Tarn: containers left in orbit for pickup.
Fly close to each container to scan it - within sixty metres for a couple of seconds. The manifests will tell us which ones carry weapons.
Destroy the contraband. The corsairs who left it may come back to collect. If they do, they are fair game.

steps.caption: Six cargo containers drift at the yard.
Scan each one by flying within 60 m of it.
Expect a corsair cutter and its fighters once the scan is done.

intel: Neutral: do not destroy clean cargo

messages.text: Yard is quiet. Start scanning, Lancer.
Containers 3 and 5 are full of Skarn munitions. Burn them. And - incoming cutter!

debrief.win: We cut a supply line, and the corsairs now know we are onto them.
debrief.lose: The contraband reached the Skarn.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The tanker Corla is filling up at Brenn depot. It needs two and a half minutes on the hose, and it cannot move while it is docked.
The depot is a big, slow, explosive target. The Skarn will want both.
Keep them alive. If the depot goes up while the Corla is docked, we lose both.

steps.caption: Brenn depot, a cluster of fuel spheres.
Tanker Corla, docked at the depot's spine.
Raiders come in from several sides. Hold for 150 seconds.

intel: Defend: tanker Corla, Brenn fuel depot (2 turrets)
Hostile: mixed Wasp and Talon raids

objectives.text: Protect the Corla and the depot

messages.text: Hose connected. Keep them off us for a few minutes.
Halfway there.
Tanks full, undocking. Thanks, Lancer.

debrief.win: The Corla is fuelled and on its way to the fleet.
debrief.lose: Brenn depot burned. The fleet will be rationing fuel.

briefing.location: Kestrel System - Wreck of the transport Ondine
briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The transport Ondine was ambushed an hour ago. Her crew got away in escape pods, and the pods' beacons are calling for help - which tells the Skarn exactly where they are.
The hospital ship Mercy is on station. Fly to each pod and pick it up with your tractor - just get within thirty metres.
Skarn fighters are hunting the pods. Get there first.

steps.caption: Hospital ship Mercy, waiting for the survivors.
Five escape pods are scattered around the wreck site.
Fly within 30 m of a pod to pick it up.
Later, bombers will go for the Mercy itself. Do not let her be hit.

intel: Hostile: Wasp hunters, then Talon bombers

objectives.text: Don't let the pods be destroyed

messages.text: Beacons are on your scope, Lancer. Please hurry.
Skarn fighters going for the pods!
Bombers on our tail! Help!

debrief.win: All of the Ondine's crew are aboard the Mercy. Every one of them.
debrief.lose: We did not get everyone out.

briefing.speaker: Lt. Commander Daro Okafor, Intelligence
text: Skarn traffic keeps vanishing into the Corvid field. There is something in there, and the survey ship Halcyon is going to find out what.
The Halcyon is slow and blind among the rocks. Fly escort to the survey point, then cover her while she takes readings for forty seconds.
Corsairs like to hide in fields like this. Watch the rocks.

steps.caption: Survey ship Halcyon, with its big sensor dish.
Her path runs through the Corvid field to the survey point.
Corsair ambushers are likely waiting in the rocks near the middle.

intel: Hazard: dense asteroid field - collisions hurt

objectives.text: Escort her to the survey point

messages.text: Entering the field. Please keep the rocks and the corsairs off us.
On station. Starting deep scan.
That is a shipyard. A Skarn shipyard, inside our space.

debrief.win: The Halcyon's scan found a Skarn shipyard hidden behind the field. That changes everything.
debrief.lose: The Halcyon is lost, and with her whatever is hiding in Corvid.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The Bastion has to move. Unfortunately, a Skarn minelayer has been sowing our exit corridor.
Mines are proximity-fused. Shoot them from a distance and never fly through the field.
The minelayer is still working at the far end. Kill it before it lays any more, then clear every mine.

steps.caption: The jump corridor, full of mines.
The minelayer is at the far end, still laying.
Mines explode when anything comes within 60 m. Shoot them from range.

messages.text: Mines on your scope. Keep your distance, Lancer.
Corridor clear. The Bastion is moving.

debrief.win: The corridor is clear and the Bastion moved to the new anchorage.
debrief.lose: The corridor is still mined. The Bastion is trapped.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The frigate Kestrel is in trouble. She caught a Skarn raid on the way back from Halden and her engines are damaged.
Two corvettes are working her over and she will not last long. Get there, get the corvettes off her, and keep the fighters away.
Lancer 2 and 3 are with you.

steps.caption: CNS Kestrel, already damaged and drifting.
Two Skarn corvettes are attacking her from the flanks.
Destroy both corvettes, and keep the Kestrel alive.

messages.text: Kestrel to any Concord fighter - we are losing shields, please hurry!
That was the last of them. Thank you, Lancer.

debrief.win: The Kestrel limped home. She will fly again.
debrief.lose: The Kestrel is lost with most of her crew.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: Tannhal station is the biggest thing we own in this system: forty thousand people living on a ring.
A Skarn strike group is coming, in three waves: fighters to clear the way, then bombers, then a corvette with heavy bombers.
Lancer 2 and 3 are with you. Do not let them hit the ring.

steps.caption: Tannhal station: a rotating ring with a central hub. Its own turrets will help.
Wave one: interceptors to clear the way.
Wave two: Talon bombers going for the station.
Wave three: a corvette with more bombers. Kill it before it gets close.

intel: Hostile: 3 waves - Wasps, Talons, corvette + Talons

messages.text: Tannhal to Lancer flight, turrets are armed. We are counting on you.
Bombers! Coming in from starboard, low!
Corvette jumping in, bearing zero-nine-zero!

debrief.win: Tannhal holds. Forty thousand people are sleeping tonight because you held the line.
debrief.lose: Tannhal was hit hard. The casualty count is still rising.

briefing.speaker: Lt. Commander Daro Okafor, Intelligence
text: Before we can do anything about the shipyard, we have to get past its defences: three turret platforms covering the approach.
Each platform is armed all round. Their weak point is the reactor core in the central sphere - shoot the core and the platform dies.
Wasps patrol between them. Use your torpedoes on the cores.

steps.caption: Three Skarn defence platforms guard the approach to Corvid.
Each one has five turrets and a reactor core in the middle.
Wasps patrol between them.

intel: Targets: 3x defence platform (5 turrets each, core)

messages.text: Platforms ahead. Cores, Lancer, aim for the cores.
The way into Corvid is open.

debrief.win: The outer defences are down. The shipyard is exposed.
debrief.lose: The platforms still hold the approach.

briefing.speaker: Lt. Commander Daro Okafor, Intelligence
text: Now we look inside. The Halcyon's scan shows a shipyard frame with something big under construction.
Fly past three sensor points close to the yard. Your cockpit records automatically. Then get out to the exit point.
Do not try to destroy the yard. You are there to look, not to fight. Get the data home.

steps.caption: The Skarn shipyard: a lattice frame around a half-built hull.
Fly past sensor points A, B and C, close to the frame.
Then leave through the exit point. Fighters will scramble once you are spotted.

intel: Recon: 3 sensor points at the yard
Hostile: yard turrets, scrambled Wasps and Talons
Do not stay - speed is your armour

objectives.text: Fly past sensor points A, B, C

messages.text: Recorders running. Low and fast, Lancer.
You have been spotted! Keep going!
Got it all. That hull is a dreadnought. Get out of there!

debrief.win: The recordings show a Skarn dreadnought nearly finished. Fleet Command has ordered the evacuation of the Kestrel colonies.
debrief.lose: The recordings were lost with your fighter.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: Fleet Command does not think we can stop the dreadnought here. The colonies are being evacuated.
The liner Aurora Star is carrying six thousand civilians to the Halden gate. She is big, slow and has no guns.
Every Skarn fighter in the system will be after her. Lancer 2 is with you. Get her to the gate.

steps.caption: Liner Aurora Star, full of evacuees.
Her route to the Halden gate, five kilometres away.
Attacks from every side. Bombers have priority.

intel: Hostile: repeated Wasp and Talon attacks

messages.text: This is Captain Lusk. We have children aboard, Lancer. Please.
Bombers above us, diving on the liner!
Gate lock... we are through. God bless you, Lancer.

debrief.win: Six thousand people are safe beyond the Halden gate.
debrief.lose: The Aurora Star never reached the gate.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: Expect company. Our scopes show a Skarn destroyer preparing to jump into our anchorage.
A destroyer can trade broadsides with the Bastion, and its bombers will try to finish us. We need its engines dead first, so it cannot close.
Knock out the three engine pods at the stern, then kill the ship.

steps.caption: The Bastion, holding position.
The destroyer jumps in here and closes on the Bastion.
Its three engine pods are at the stern. Destroy them to stop it.
Talon bombers will launch at the Bastion. Do not ignore them.

intel: Target: Skarn destroyer (6 turrets, 3 engine pods)

messages.text: All fighters, stand by. Jump signature building.
Destroyer in the anchorage! Go for the engines!
It is dead in space. Finish it.

debrief.win: The destroyer Gorran is gone. The Bastion took hits, but she is still the Bastion.
debrief.lose: The Bastion is badly damaged. The fleet has lost its carrier.

briefing.speaker: Lt. Commander Daro Okafor, Intelligence
text: We know where the prisoners from the Ondine and the Tarn yard are: on a Skarn prison barge waiting for transfer.
The barge has six turrets. Take out every turret - but do not destroy the barge itself, there are four hundred of our people inside.
When it is defenceless, the guards will surrender and the barge will be ours. Then the Skarn will come to destroy it rather than lose it. Hold until the Kestrel arrives to tow it.

steps.caption: The prison barge: six turrets, four hundred prisoners. Do NOT destroy the hull.
Destroy all six turrets.
Then defend the barge until CNS Kestrel arrives to tow it.

intel: Do not destroy: prison barge hull
Hostile: Wasp guards, then a Talon strike

objectives.text: The barge must not be destroyed
Defend the barge until the Kestrel arrives

messages.text: Turrets only, Lancer. Steady hands.
This is the barge. The guards have surrendered! Skarn bombers are coming for us!
Tow lines attached. We are taking them home.

debrief.win: Four hundred of our people are free. Many of them are already asking to fly.
debrief.lose: The barge was lost with everyone aboard.

briefing.speaker: Lt. Commander Daro Okafor, Intelligence
text: Someone has been feeding the Skarn our patrol routes. We finally know how: a Skarn stealth prototype shadowing our fleet.
It does not show on scanners beyond seven hundred metres. Our sensor buoys have caught it passing, so it is somewhere in this volume.
Find it and kill it. It is fragile once you have found it, but its escorts are not.

steps.caption: Sensor buoys mark where the prototype was last seen.
It follows a loop through this area. It only appears on scanners within 700 m.
Four Wasps guard it. Kill the prototype first if you can.

intel: Target: Skarn stealth prototype (radar range 700 m)
Visit the buoys to narrow the search

messages.text: It is out there somewhere. Watch for a contact that appears out of nowhere.
Got it. They are blind again.

debrief.win: The prototype is destroyed. The Skarn have lost their eyes on our fleet.
debrief.lose: The ghost is still out there, watching us.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The corsairs who supplied the Skarn live in a hollowed-out asteroid deep in Corvid. With the shipyard nearby, it is their depot and their repair yard.
The base is protected by two shield generators on its surface. Bring them down, and then the reactor on top of the dome is exposed.
Cutters patrol the nest. Torpedoes are loaded.

steps.caption: Asteroid Hollow, the corsair base.
Two shield generators on the surface protect it. Destroy them first.
Then the reactor on top of the dome. It kills the whole base.
Corsair cutters and fighters defend it.

intel: Target: corsair base (2 shield generators, reactor, 6 turrets)

messages.text: Hollow ahead. Ugly place.
Shields are down. Hit the reactor on the dome!
Hollow is gone. The Skarn just lost their friends.

debrief.win: Asteroid Hollow is rubble. The shipyard has lost its suppliers.
debrief.lose: The corsairs are still in business.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The Skarn are tired of us. A heavy cruiser is coming straight for the Bastion, with escorts.
It is shielded by two generators on the dorsal hull. While they are up, our guns cannot hurt it. Take the generators down, then the cruiser.
The Kestrel will support you. Everyone else who can fly is in the air.

steps.caption: The Bastion and the frigate Kestrel hold the anchorage.
A Skarn heavy cruiser is advancing on us.
Two shield generators on its back. Destroy them, then the cruiser.
Bombers will try to slip past while you are busy.

intel: Target: Skarn heavy cruiser (8 turrets, 2 shield generators)

messages.text: Here it comes. Lancer flight, generators first.
Its shields are down! All guns, fire!
The Iron Vow is gone. Well done, all of you.

debrief.win: The Iron Vow broke on the Bastion's defences. One ship is left: the dreadnought.
debrief.lose: The cruiser reached the Bastion.

briefing.speaker: Commander Ilse Varn, CO, CNS Bastion
text: The dreadnought has left the yard. If it reaches Kestrel Prime, the war in this sector is over and we have lost it.
It is nine hundred metres of armour. Four shield generators protect it. Then four engines - if it is dead in space, we can win. Then the reactor in the dorsal trench.
This is everything we have. Lancer, bring it down.

steps.caption: The Skarn dreadnought, nine hundred metres long, advancing on the Bastion.
Step one: four shield generators on the dorsal superstructure.
Step two: its four engines at the stern.
Step three: the reactor in the dorsal trench forward of the tower.
Two corvettes and its fighters screen it. The Bastion and Kestrel will hold back the bombers.

intel: Target: Skarn dreadnought (22 turrets, 4 shield gens, 4 engines, reactor)
Hostile: 2 corvettes, many Wasps and Talons
Support: CNS Bastion, CNS Kestrel, Lancer 2-4

messages.text: This is it. Every pilot, every gun. Hammerfall.
Shields down! Now the engines at the stern!
It is dead in space! Into the trench, Lancer, hit the reactor!
It is breaking up... It is over. Bring them home.

debrief.win: The Hammer of Skarn is gone. Without it, the Skarn offensive is over. The Kestrel Frontier is free, and every pilot aboard the Bastion knows who struck the final blow.
debrief.lose: The dreadnought reached Kestrel Prime. The frontier has fallen.
